notes: DM-NVX-360 is a 4K60 4:4:4 AV-over-IP encoder/decoder (works as either transmitter or receiver). HDMI in/out support HDCP 2.3, HDR10/HDR10+/Dolby Vision, up to 4096x2160@60 4:4:4 — graded hdmi-2.0 (spec does not explicitly state "2.0" version number but bandwidth/feature set, incl. 4K60 4:4:4 + HDR, matches HDMI 2.0; not confirmed verbatim as "HDMI 2.0" in source, so treat as inferred). Ethernet 1 supports PoE+ (802.3at) as power sourcing equipment input, not shown as a separate power port. Ethernet 3 is limited to 100BASE-TX (100m) per spec while Ethernet 1/2 are 100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T (eth-1g). Ethernet 4 is an SFP cage accepting a Crestron SFP-1G transceiver (graded eth-1g). USB Device is USB-C (2.0 speed only, not USB-C's higher data modes) and USB Host / USB HID are USB-A (2.0). Audio I/O is a 5-pin 3.5mm captive/detachable terminal block carrying balanced/unbalanced stereo line-level audio (configurable input or output) — modeled here as bidirectional trs-3.5 combining both channels into one physical connector since it's a single 5-pin block, not two mono euroblocks. IR 1-2 is a 4-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block (mapped to nearest connector id "trs-3.5" is not appropriate since it's a multi-pin terminal block for two IR/serial ports, not a single audio jack; mapped to euroblock as closest screw-terminal analog). COM is a 5-pin 3.5mm detachable terminal block, bidirectional RS-232 (mapped to euroblock as closest screw-terminal connector, since no bare "terminal block RS232" id exists). Power input is 24VDC 1.25A via 2.1x5.5mm barrel connector (dc-barrel). Chassis ground lug (6-32 screw) omitted as not a signal/power I/O port in the required sense. Device is freestanding/surface-mount/single-rack-rail — not a standard rack-unit (RU) product, so rackUnits omitted. A companion model DM-NVX-360C has a slightly different form factor; do not confuse.
